outlets.name: The place's / franchise's own official site
outlets.credible: Owner's own page — corroborates facts/status only; never one of the two credible sources on its own for a restaurant (Japan brief).

outlets.name: Anime Tourism Association — '88 Anime Spots' (animetourism88.com)
outlets.credible: Annual pilgrimage-site selection by the Anime Tourism Association (KADOKAWA/JTB/JAL et al.); counts as one credible source per the Japan brief.

outlets.name: 4Gamer.net
outlets.credible: Long-running major Japanese games/anime news outlet with named editors; corroborating.

outlets.name: Hakodate Morning Market cooperative (hakodate-asaichi.com)
outlets.credible: The market body's own member directory — a local institution curating its members (not the shop's own site); one corroborating local source.

outlets.name: Kushiro & Lake Akan Tourism (kushiro-lakeakan.com)
outlets.credible: Official site of the Kushiro City / Lake Akan tourism association — tourism body of record.

outlets.name: Time Out (Tokyo/Japan)
outlets.credible: International city-guide brand with named editors (Japan brief: TIMEOUT).

outlets.name: トラベルjp (travel.co.jp)
outlets.credible: Japanese editorial travel-guide site written by named 'navigator' writers; corroborating.

outlets.name: Impress Travel Watch
outlets.credible: Japanese travel-industry news (Impress Watch) with named reporters; corroborating.

outlets.name: Tōyako Onsen Tourism Association (laketoya.com)
outlets.credible: Official tourism association of Tōyako Onsen — tourism body of record.

outlets.name: Niseko Promotion Board (niseko-ta.jp)
outlets.credible: Official Niseko town tourism organisation — tourism body of record.

outlets.name: Obihiro Tourism & Convention Association (obikan.jp)
outlets.credible: Official Obihiro tourism body — tourism body of record.

outlets.name: Rishiri Plus (rishiri-plus.jp) — Rishiri Island tourism portal
outlets.credible: Island tourism portal listing local shops ('shima-shop'); one corroborating local source.
